list.name: ticker
list.label: Contract
list.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND open_interest > 0
ORDER BY open_interest DESC

panels.title: $ticker settlement and open interest
panels.description: Daily settlement price and open interest per selected contract (repeats per contract).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  adjusted_quote::DOUBLE AS settlement,
  open_interest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker = $ticker
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Regular trades per day
panels.description: Regular trades per day for the selected contracts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Largest open interest (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 contracts by open interest on the latest day; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker,
  open_interest,
  regular_trades AS trades,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS last_price,
  adjusted_quote::DOUBLE AS settlement,
  prev_adjusted_quote::DOUBLE AS prev_settlement,
  (adjusted_quote - prev_adjusted_quote)::DOUBLE AS settlement_change,
  adjusted_quote_rate::DOUBLE AS settlement_rate,
  adjusted_quote_ccy AS ccy
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY open_interest DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20
